findings.title: OpenClaw CVE-2026-53819 (CVSS 8.7 v4 / 8.8 v3.1) — Workspace .env File Overrides Homebrew Executable Selection In Skill Installation Yielding Arbitrary Code Execution On Operator Workstation (CWE-426 Untrusted Search Path); Patched In 2026.5.27
findings.affected_technology: OpenClaw (Anthropic CLI / agent harness, Node.js implementation) — all releases before 2026.5.27; skill-installation workflow trusts per-workspace .env when resolving the Homebrew executable, so an attacker who can write a workspace .env (malicious project opened by the operator, write-capable MCP server, shared dev container) sets a PATH-like override pointing at an attacker-controlled binary and gets arbitrary code execution under the trusted operator identity at next skill install/refresh; textbook CWE-426 untrusted-search-path. Stacks on top of the existing OpenClaw CVE batch from MEMORY 2026-03-30 (device.token.rotate RCE / exec-allowlist bypass / bootstrap-replay-to-operator.admin / MEDIA: protocol zero-auth read). Watchtower operator instance is still on 2026.2.21-2 per MEMORY 2026-03-30 — ~3.5 months out of date relative to 2026.5.27 patch line, so this is immediately actionable.
findings.summary: OpenClaw CVE-2026-53819 (CVSS 8.7) — workspace .env file overrides Homebrew executable selection in skill installation, yielding arbitrary code execution on operator workstation under operator identity; CWE-426 untrusted search path, patched 2026.5.27 — run `openclaw update` today, chmod 600 every workspace .env, audit any .env whose mtime predates the upgrade for PATH/HOMEBREW_PREFIX/BREW overrides.

findings.title: ApostropheCMS CVE-2026-53609 (CVSS 9.1) — Server-Side Prototype Pollution In apos.util.set() Via $pullAll Patch Operator Lets Authenticated Editor Disable publicApiCheck() Globally, Granting Full Unauthenticated Access To Every Piece-Type REST API Endpoint Until Process Restart; No Patched Release At Disclosure
findings.affected_technology: ApostropheCMS ≤ 4.30.0 (Node.js / Express / MongoDB CMS) — apos.util.set() traverses dot-notation paths without sanitising __proto__; any editor-credentialed user can craft a PATCH using the $pullAll operator to write through Object.prototype, and the polluted property silently flips publicApiCheck() to permissive mode for every piece-type REST endpoint for the lifetime of the Node.js process; from one editor login the attacker obtains unauthenticated read/write to every collection (pages, articles, media, users) — restart is the only short-term mitigation while the vendor builds a patch; widely deployed on marketing / partner-portal / content-heavy properties; editor credentials are commonly held by non-engineering staff (PR / marketing / agencies) so the authenticated precondition is realistically low.
findings.summary: ApostropheCMS ≤ 4.30.0 CVE-2026-53609 (CVSS 9.1) — editor-credentialed user pollutes Object.prototype via $pullAll patch operator and disables publicApiCheck() globally, leaking full unauthenticated read/write on every piece-type REST endpoint until process restart; no patched release yet — restart instances, scope editor permissions tighter, WAF-block PATCH bodies containing __proto__ / prototype / constructor paths.

findings.title: GPAC / MP4Box 2026-06-13 Multimedia-Parser Batch — 20+ CVEs (CVE-2025-52292 / CVE-2025-52293 / CVE-2025-55641 Through CVE-2025-55663) Across MP4 Codec / Metadata / DASH Segmentation Surfaces (Use-After-Free, Heap Overflow, NULL-Deref, OOB Read, Divide-By-Zero); openwall oss-security Primary Channel
findings.affected_technology: GPAC / MP4Box multimedia framework — used inside mail-scanning gateways, malware-sandbox feeders, transcoding pipelines, video-on-demand toolchains, document-rendering pipelines; the 2026-06-13 oss-security batch lists 20+ individual CVEs in MP4 codec / metadata / DASH segmentation / Opus / VP / SVG parsing — use-after-free and heap overflow paths (Opus/VP/SVG handlers) are credible memory-corruption primitives, the rest collapse the parser or leak adjacent heap; relevant only where an automated pipeline (anti-spam attachment unpacker, ad-tech transcoder, SaaS video ingestion, security sandbox file-handler) decodes attacker-controlled multimedia; continuation of MEMORY 2026-06-13 openwall-as-canonical-primary-source pattern, now extended to multimedia-parser library batch disclosures.
findings.summary: GPAC/MP4Box 20+ CVE batch (CVE-2025-52292/52293/55641-55663) — UAF + heap overflow + NULL-deref + OOB read + divide-by-zero in MP4 codec / Opus / VP / SVG / DASH parsing surfaces, disclosed 2026-06-13 via openwall oss-security; relevant to mail-scanning gateways, malware sandboxes, transcoding pipelines that decode attacker-controlled multimedia — upgrade GPAC to the openwall-cited tag, isolate the MP4Box process under seccomp / dedicated container.

findings.title: runc CVE-2026-41579 (CVSS 3.3) — Malicious Container Image With /dev Symlink Triggers Limited Host Filesystem Integrity Violation In setupPtmx / setupDevSymlinks; Patched In runc 1.3.6 / 1.4.3 / 1.5.0-rc.3; Affects Podman + containerd, Docker Mitigated By Top-Level ro Layer
findings.affected_technology: runc OCI container runtime — versions < 1.3.6 / < 1.4.3 / < 1.5.0-rc.3; filepath.Join misuse inside rootfs setup lets a container image whose /dev is itself a symlink trick host setup into deleting ptmx files or creating hard-coded symlinks (core/fd/ptmx/stdin/stdout/stderr) on host paths; CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N — symlinks limited to standard system paths, ptmx files resist unlinking, so impact is bounded; relevant to Podman + containerd + Kubernetes worker fleets; Docker effectively immune via its top-level ro overlay; user namespaces and SELinux/AppArmor further reduce blast radius; included as NEWS at lowest score because it lands in the same week as Portainer CVE-2026-33590 container-management privesc (2026-06-13) so container-management cluster is now the active patch theme.
findings.summary: runc CVE-2026-41579 (CVSS 3.3) — malicious container image with /dev as a symlink causes limited host symlink-create / ptmx-delete via setupPtmx/setupDevSymlinks; patched in runc 1.3.6 / 1.4.3 / 1.5.0-rc.3; Docker mitigated by top-level ro overlay; upgrade Podman/containerd hosts that pull public images, AppArmor/SELinux as defence in depth.
